entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Make Room

*A clipped order sends one companion into the opening before it closes.*

One willing active ally within 3 squares that can hear it may spend that ally’s Reaction to move up to 2 squares. Movement provokes normally and pays terrain costs. An uncommanded summon cannot act; summons have no Reaction to spend.

entries.name: Rally at the Blow
entries.effect: After an ally within 3 takes HP damage: reduce Frightened 1; ward its next defense.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Rally at the Blow

*A sharp call catches the wounded companion's attention before pain can turn into panic.*

After a visible willing ally within 3 squares takes HP damage from an attack, reduce that ally's Frightened by 1 if it can hear this creature. Then give it 1 Boon on its next defense before the start of this creature's next turn; for an NPC ally impose 1 Bane on the corresponding player attack. The defense benefit is consumed on that roll even if canceled and does not stack with itself. No healing or action is granted.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Lifeless Body — Passive:** Does not breathe or eat; only its listed immunities apply.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

**Healing:** Healing-harmed: ordinary healing resolves as Life damage instead; no beneficial riders.

**Against offensive healing:** Its controller uses Fortitude defense when player-controlled; a player attacking it rolls only their attack.

**Senses:** Dark sight 6 squares; ordinary hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Keep a guard between itself and a challenger; spend Make Room only when that guard still has a Reaction.

**Encounter and conversation:** The royal seal commands the wrong heir; deciphering the succession can divide its servants.

**Habitat:** Crypt; burial ground; ruined settlement · **Communication:** Common; understands old oaths

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.

Use the attributes above for defenses named by incoming attacks. Same targeting, limits and costs apply; no opposed second roll.

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 4/7/10

**Reference type:** Life

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.4

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.3 → 1.4: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.000, O=8.518. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [Clinging Recoil](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/clinging-recoil.md), [commanding step](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/commanding-step.md), [dread cry](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/dread-cry.md), [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md), [Rally at the Blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/rally-at-the-blow.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.

# Clinging Recoil

*Something catches the striking limb: a clutching hand, a string of slime or a fold of adhesive flesh that drags at the next hurried step.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-clinging-recoil

**Action:** Reaction

After an adjacent attacker’s attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, apply Slowed 2 to that attacker. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. This grants no grapple, extra damage or equipment destruction.
